pkgmetadata.longdescription: The native (Go) implementation of the TypeScript compiler, released as TypeScript 7 ("TypeScript Native Preview", tsgo). Installed version-slotted as /usr/bin/tsgo-VERSION, with the compiler and its lib*.d.ts files in /usr/lib/typescript-native/VERSION/, mirroring the layout of upstream's npm platform packages. Primarily a build dependency of www-client/chromium, which pins an exact version.
